clips.text: Your gas meter looks fiddly. It isn't. Reading it takes about a minute.
First, find it. Gas meters often live in a box outside, in the hall, or under the stairs.
Now look at the row of numbers. Write them down from left to right, just as you see them.
Stop when you reach a red number, or a decimal point. Anything after that, you can ignore.
That's your reading. Give it to your energy supplier. On their app, their website, or over the phone.
Why bother? Because then your bill is based on what you really used. Not on a guess.
